title: Construction of magnesium–molybdenum–phosphorus multi-component flame retardant and its performance in flexible PVC composites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30046-30061
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04341G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xue Li, Xiaoyuan Liu, Zhihui Lv, Li Dang
To address the high flammability and toxic smoke emission of flexible PVC (fPVC), a Mg–Mo–P multi-component flame retardant (MO@MH-PEPE) was constructed by modifying MoO3-hybridized Mg(OH)2 with phenolic epoxy phosphate ester.
